outline.chapter_title: 2. Legal Framework: Refugee Admission, the Refugee Act, and the APA
outline.description: Outlines the statutory regimes relevant to the case, focusing on the Refugee Act of 1980, the administrative procedures governing the USRAP, and the procedural standards for injunctions and APA claims.

outline.chapter_title: 3. Analysis of the President’s Authority to Suspend Refugee Admissions
outline.description: Examines why the Ninth Circuit concludes the executive order satisfies the statutory requirements for a suspension and why it is unlikely to be overturned on a merits review.

outline.description: Explores whether § 1522 creates an enforceable obligation for the federal government to provide services to refugees already admitted before the suspension.
